title: Symmetry-Based Perspectives on Hamiltonian Quantum Search Algorithms and Schrodinger's Dynamics between Orthogonal States
summary: It is known that the continuous-time variant of Grover's search algorithm is characterized by quantum search frameworks that are governed by stationary Hamiltonians, which result in search trajectories confined to the two-dimensional subspace of the complete Hilbert space formed by the source and target states. Specifically, the search approach is ineffective when the source and target states are orthogonal.
